decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-84b2ea8b3c0e] names the subject (the termcolor dependency), the change (version bump from 2.5.0 to 3.0.1) and the scope (the repository path /hack/api-docs, filed as a dependabot chore(deps) change). That is enough to write the applicability aspect: the change is limited to repo docs tooling, so no deployed environment is exposed, and the consequence is none/informational. One caveat: the locator puts the line under a 'BREAKING CHANGES › What's Changed' heading. It appears to be part of the general change list, but the release text does not say that, and saying no deployment is exposed is my reading of the path rather than an explicit statement.
